column2: The protein that makes the jellyfish Aequorea victoria flash blue when calcium binds. Osamu Shimomura found it alongside green fluorescent protein, which earned him a share of the 2008 Nobel Prize.
A DNA polymerase from Thermus aquaticus, a bacterium from Yellowstone's hot springs. It survives the heat of PCR, which made PCR practical, so anyone who's run one knows the name.
